main_text.p: illis difcedat. Jubent pacem coli, charitatique ftudere omnes volunt: vetant ullum novationis convitium fieri illis, qui formulis confenfus adhærent. Sic ibi transactum hactenus pacificè.

Quantum ab his diverfi funt Spanhemius ejufque Fratres ? Claffes Auftralis Hollandiæ negant inter ipfos effe qui ab orthodoxia deficiant. Fratres Spanhemii vociferantur plures inter ipfos effe αἱρε- δοξʒς perniciofæ doctrinæ reos. Claffes Novatores ignorant talefque in illa Hollandiæ parte reperiri negant, nomen autem Novatorum ut contumeliofum exulare jubent; Fratres vero Spanhemii indies magis magifque & quafi revocatis viribus in accufationem Fratrum coëunt, eofque novitatis reos agunt. Claffes declarant nullum fuorum membrorum à formulis confenfus receffiffe iifve nuntium miffe; Spanhemius omnes has affertiones & obteftationes nihili facit, atque odiofa nec non infolenti hac cum Remonftrantium geftis comparatione perfidiæ & hypocrifeos fufpicionem in fratres jacere non
main_text.notes: Greek word on line "effe ... reos" is printed as αἱρε-/δοξʒς (heretical); transcribed as printed with a hyphen split across lines. The word "Spanhemii" in the line "Spanhemii in-" is the printed form. Catchword "non" at foot right.
